quarterly_data.quarter: Planet Labs press release: Planet Launches Suncatcher, Tanager-2, and 18 SuperDove (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Planet launched 20 satellites aboard SpaceX's Transporter-18 rideshare from Vandenberg Space Force Base: the first demo mission for Google's Project Suncatcher (developed in partnership with Google; it will run the first-ever test of Google's TPUs in space, exploring the feasibility of in-orbit ML compute), Tanager-2 hyperspectral satellite and 18 SuperDoves (Flock 4J, supplementing PlanetScope). Initial contact was made with Tanager-2, the Suncatcher prototype and two SuperDoves; the remaining 16 SuperDoves deploy from the D-Orbit ION orbital transfer vehicle. It was Planet's 40th successful launch, for a total of 718 satellites built and delivered on orbit. Tanager (developed with Carbon Mapper) images 426 contiguous bands at ~5 nm spectral and 30 m spatial resolution, and Planet plans to build and deploy at least three additional Tanager satellites with Carbon Mapper.
quarterly_data.figure: 20 satellites launched; 40th successful launch; 718 satellites on orbit in total; at least three additional Tanagers planned
